_readme: Branch list used when no backend is configured (with a backend, admin.html > Branches is the source of truth and this file is ignored). Set "listed": false to hide a branch from the site; "phone" is that branch's own call line (the WhatsApp ordering number stays shared). lat/lng are approximate neighbourhood pins — replace with the exact shopfront location for accurate delivery fees.
